rows.notes: [SC196 2026-11-27] Dated built step: the Qujing 110,000 t/yr LMFP project (Qujing Dynanonic) 'officially put into operation' on 2022-09-19 (SMM, S1; the same article gives the long-term 2025 targets of 440,000 t LMFP / 345,000 t LFP, which are plans and are NOT used). This is the LMFP project only: it is a FLOOR for the Qujing base, which also has earlier LFP lines and the Dynanonic-EVE Qujing JV entity (base total undisclosed; group total built 450,000 t at end-2025 per the 2025 annual report, local text 300769_2025.txt line 901, not allocable to sites). Unit kept as t CAM (same unit as the row).

[SC196 2026-11-27] Jiangxi Shenghua 20万吨 high-compaction LFP project at Yichun: phase 1 'officially put into production in September 2024 ... 6 lines built ... capacity 7.5万吨' (Solarbe/锂电焦点 reprint, published 2025-03-12). Month precision only (installed_as_of '2024-09'). Phase 2 started construction Dec 2024 with first line planned May 2025 - not confirmed, not counted. FLOOR for the Yichun base: any earlier Jiangxi Shenghua lines are not covered by this figure. Press source only; no company filing found that splits capacity by base (the 2025 annual report has no per-base capacity). [lead] confidence capped at 0.5: key field rests on reported evidence.

[SC196 2026-11-27] Phase 1 = 100,000 t: the project is two phases of 10万吨 each (MarkLines 2022-08-16, S5). Phase 1 production start Aug 2022 (S5 says the 20万吨 base 'put into production' in Meishan, 16 Aug 2022; a 2022-10-19 Zheshang report snippet says 'phase 1 10万吨 already in production in August', S7, reported tier). The 2025 annual report (S4) still lists phase 1 as in production and phase 2 as not built (only warehouse/dormitory under construction), so 100,000 t is stated as installed at 2025-12-31. The phase-1 size is inferred from the stated 2 x 10万吨 phasing; the annual report gives no phase capacity. Plan (200,000 t) unchanged.

[SC196 2026-11-27] Yunnan Shanshan Anning: production started 30 Jun 2023 for phase 1 with 'planned capacity of 200,000 tonnes per year', phase 2 (100,000 t) not started (Fastmarkets 2023-07-07, S6). The 2025 annual report (S4) lists phase 1 as in production and phase 2 as not started, so 200,000 t is recorded as installed at 2025-12-31. CAVEAT: S6 gives phase-1 capacity as 'planned', and no filing states the phase-1 capacity actually built or the utilisation, so this may overstate built capacity if phase 1 was commissioned in stages (CIP at end-2025 was 43% of the CNY 9.7bn budget for the whole 30万吨 base, S4 line 6942). Plan (300,000 t) unchanged.
